seoTitle: Clément DOUIN | Tailor-made software & AI for small businesses
seoDesc: Freelance developer and creator of Himalaya/Pimalaya. Tailor-made, self-hosted business software with AI, built for small businesses.
title: Tailor-made software, powered by AI
lead1: I design and build custom business software with AI built in — invoicing, scheduling, client records, mail and calendar automation — for small businesses that don't have the time to figure out what AI can already do for them. Every install is self-hosted and stays yours.
lead2: Ten years as an independent developer, three of them on Himalaya, an open-source email client used worldwide and funded by the NLnet foundation and the European Commission.
